page.overview:
What is Artificial Devil Fruit?

Artificial Devil Fruits are man-made replicas of naturally-existing Devil Fruits created by scientists by synthesizing or manipulating the Lineage Factor in attempts to replicate the powers of certain fruits so that others can hold that power at the same time as the real user.

The creation of artificial Devil Fruits has been accomplished by two scientists who once belonged to the research institute MADS: the world-esteemed Dr. Vegapunk and the pirate outlaw Caesar Clown. Vegapunk perfected his process while working for the World Government, producing an artificial replica of the Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu and later copying the powers of certain Paramecia-types through Green Blood flowing through his Seraphim weapons. Caesar, meanwhile, helped to mass-produce the high-risk, imperfect SMILE fruits under the employ of Donquixote Doflamingo, specifically to be sold to Kaidou.

Artificial Devil Fruits are created based on Dr. Vegapunk's research on how Devil Fruits affect the user's Lineage Factor, making practical applications of such effects on the blood. However, Vegapunk's and Caesar's development methods were radically different. While Vegapunk utilized the Lineage Factor of an already existing fruit user to develop his artificial fruit, Caesar utilized the Lineage Factor of regular animals. Thus, Caesar was only ever capable of producing replicas of Zoan-type fruits, whereas Vegapunk found a way to replicate Paramecia fruit powers as well. According to Vegapunk, Logia-type powers are too difficult to recreate despite his best efforts.

Both Vegapunk's and Caesar's artificial fruits take away the consumer's ability to swim, much like a natural Devil Fruit. However, as evidenced by the unusual effects of both scientists' fruits compared to natural Devil Fruits, producing a normal Devil Fruit through man-made means is extremely difficult, if not impossible, to the point that even Vegapunk, the smartest man in the world, has serious difficulty successfully pulling it off.
